_comment: The ComfyUI workflow a new rival's portrait is painted with, when the player switches ComfyUI on in Settings (see
docs/modding.md, "ai"). A mod's ai/comfy_portrait.json takes the place of this one whole (a graph is not merged).
workflow: the graph in ComfyUI's API format (in ComfyUI: Save (API Format)); any graph works, a Z-Image Turbo txt2img here,
with the same nodes as the base game's own portraits (Utils/Opponent Creation/comfyui-workflow.json).
fill: which node input gets which of the game's values, each { node: the node's id in the graph, input: its input }:
positive (prompt, filled), negative (negative, filled), seed (random each time), width and height (below),
checkpoint (below: the model the graph loads; left as the graph has it when empty), prefix (the file name ComfyUI saves under).
checkpoint: the model file as ComfyUI lists it (here a diffusion model of models/diffusion_models, with the Qwen3 4B
text encoder and the ae VAE the graph names): change it to one you have. Z-Image Turbo samples at cfg 1, so the negative is not
used by this graph; a graph of guidance above 1 takes it.
prompt and negative take the game's {placeholders}: {look} (the text AI's description, empty without one), {name},
prompt: 1960s American street racer portrait, {sex} aged {age}, {look}, dark garage or night street background, chrome reflections, cinematic low-key lighting, vintage film grain, realistic mid-century photography
negative: modern clothing, modern hairstyle, contemporary fashion, digital art, illustration, cartoon, anime, cgi, 3d render, unrealistic skin, plastic skin, oversharpened, overprocessed, glamour lighting, studio portrait, selfie, smartphone photo, celebrity, famous person, perfect symmetry, deformed face, extra limbs, extra fingers, missing fingers, distorted anatomy, warped face, low resolution, blurry, out of focus, watermark, text, logo
